No. Hansen/UMD mapped tree-cover loss of about 81.3 ha in 2021, which is only 2.23% of the 3,643.5 ha property. The evidence is corroborated: later years were observed, and the JRC 2020 forest reference agrees on 98% of the loss area.

Most of the loss (68.1 ha) falls in mapped planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda). None is in native forest, and 13.2 ha is outside mapped forest. Another 37.3 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha is not counted in the 81.3 ha figure.

This does not show deforestation or land-use change, because Hansen loss includes any stand replacement, such as harvesting a plantation. It also doesn't establish the cause, legality, responsible party, or any compliance status.
